subcommands.name: associate-team-member
subcommands.description: Adds an IAM user to the team for an AWS CodeStar project

options.name: --project-id
options.description: The ID of the project to which you will add the IAM user

options.name: --client-request-token
options.description: A user- or system-generated token that identifies the entity that requested the team member association to the project.

options.name: --user-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the IAM user you want to add to the AWS CodeStar project

options.name: --project-role
options.description: The AWS CodeStar project role that will apply to this user.

options.name: --remote-access-allowed
options.description: Whether the team member is allowed to use an SSH public/private key pair to remotely access project resources, for example Amazon EC2 instances

options.name: --no-remote-access-allowed
options.description: Whether the team member is allowed to use an SSH public/private key pair to remotely access project resources, for example Amazon EC2 instances

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
